# Data Preprocess

```{r}
library(dplyr)
work_dir = "../semi-transfer-learning/results_5_dim8"

compare_work_dir = "../semi-transfer-learning/results_5_dim8"
compare_work_dir="../results_11_dim8"
methods_replace <- c("Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_lasso", "pERM_Transfer")
methods_replace <- c("Pooled")

read_folder_make_output <- function(folder_path, n, similarity) {

  rds_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

  read_and_add_metadata <- function(file) {
    data <- tryCatch(readRDS(file), error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Error reading %s: %s", file, e))
      return(NULL)
    })
    if (is.null(data)) return(NULL)

    data$method <- rownames(data)
    data$dataset <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(file))
    data$seed <- as.numeric(sub(".*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", data$dataset))
    data
  }

  rds_data <- lapply(rds_files, read_and_add_metadata)
  rds_data <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rds_data)
  all_data <- do.call(rbind, rds_data)
  all_data <- all_data[order(all_data$seed), ]

  max_per_row    <- apply(all_data[, 1:5], 1, max)
  mean_per_row   <- apply(all_data[, 1:5], 1, mean)
  median_per_row <- apply(all_data[, 1:5], 1, median)

  output <- data.frame(
    max_value    = max_per_row,
    mean_value   = mean_per_row,
    median_value = median_per_row,
    task1 = all_data[, 1],
    task2 = all_data[, 2],
    task3 = all_data[, 3],
    task4 = all_data[, 4],
    task5 = all_data[, 5],
    seed  = all_data$seed,
    method = all_data$method,
    n = n,
    similarity = similarity
  )

  output
}

# -------------------------
# Main (replace 3 methods)
# -------------------------
setwd(work_dir)

all_combined <- NULL

for (n in c(100, 200)) {
  for (similarity in similarity_list) {

    folder_base <- file.path(work_dir, sprintf("mse_n_%d_simi_%s", n, similarity))
    folder_cmp  <- file.path(compare_work_dir, sprintf("mse_n_%d_simi_%s%s", n, similarity, "lambda_len100"))

    output_file <- sprintf("%s/mse_n_%d_simi_%.2f.RData", work_dir, n, similarity)

    base_out <- read_folder_make_output(folder_base, n, similarity)
    cmp_out  <- read_folder_make_output(folder_cmp,  n, similarity)

    # replace: keep non-replaced methods from base, and take replaced methods from compare
    final_out <- bind_rows(
      base_out %>% filter(!(method %in% methods_replace)),
      cmp_out  %>% filter(method %in% methods_replace)
    ) %>%
      arrange(method, seed)

    # save back to the SAME file (in work_dir)
    output <- final_out
    save(output, file = output_file)

    all_combined <- bind_rows(all_combined, final_out)
  }
}

```

```{r}
files

prepare_data <- function(result, file_name) {
  # Define methods to analyze
  methods <- c("Baseline", "Sai_Transfer", "Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", "pERM_Transfer", "Pooled")

  # Generate quantile data for each method
  quantiles_list <- lapply(methods, function(m) {
    # 1 meas max and 2 means mean
    quantile_df <- apply(result[result$method == m, "mean_value", drop = FALSE], 2, function(col) {
      quantile(col, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
    })
    colnames(quantile_df) <- m
    quantile_df
  })

  # Combine quantile data and reshape it to long format
  quantiles <- do.call(cbind, quantiles_list)
  quantiles_long <- melt(quantiles, variable.name = "Method", value.name = "Value")
  
  # Add a column with the file name for faceting
  quantiles_long$Dataset <- basename(file_name)
  
  return(quantiles_long)
}




load(files[1])
all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(file) {
  result <- load(file)
  result <- get(result)
  prepare_data(result, file)
}))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract 'n' (e.g., 200 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    n = as.numeric(gsub(".*_n_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Dataset)),
    
    # Extract 'similarity' (e.g., 0.4 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    similarity = as.numeric(gsub(".*_simi_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?).*", "\\1", Dataset))

all_data <- all_data %>%
```

# Data Preprocess


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Define sample sizes and similarity values
sample_sizes <- c(100, 200)
similarity_values <- similarity_list

# Initialize a list to store the loaded data frames
combined_results <- list()

custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("", value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)
for (n in sample_sizes) {
  for (sim in similarity_values) {
    folder_path <- paste0("../semi-transfer-learning/CATE_dim8/CATE_", 
                        n, "_", sim)
    rdata_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)
    
    seed_val <- 0
    for (file in rdata_files) {
      seed_val <- seed_val + 1
      
      temp_env <- new.env()
      load(file, envir = temp_env)
      
      # Identify the data object (assumes it's called 'result' or the first non-'seed' object)
      obj_names <- setdiff(ls(envir = temp_env), "seed")
      if ("result" %in% obj_names) {
        data_obj <- temp_env$result
      } else {
        data_obj <- get(obj_names[1], envir = temp_env)
      }
      
      # Convert to a data frame, if needed
      data_obj <- as.data.frame(data_obj)
      
      # Record n, similarity, and seed
      data_obj$n <- n
      data_obj$similarity <- sim
      data_obj$seed <- seed_val
      
      combined_results[[length(combined_results) + 1]] <- data_obj
    }
  }
}

final_combined <- do.call(rbind, combined_results)

save(final_combined, file = "../semi-transfer-learning/CATE_dim8/final_combined_results.RData")
temp1 <- final_combined[final_combined$similarity == 0 & final_combined$n==100,]$Task1[grep("Baseline", rownames(final_combined))]
temp2 <- final_combined[final_combined$similarity == 0 & final_combined$n==100,]$Task1[grep("Pooled", rownames(final_combined))]

median_temp1 <- median(temp1[is.finite(temp1)], na.rm = TRUE)
median_temp2 <- median(temp2[is.finite(temp2)], na.rm = TRUE)
median_temp1
median_temp2
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)

# Load the processed data
load("../semi-transfer-learning/CATE_dim8/final_combined_results.RData")  # Adjust path if necessary

# If method names are stored as row names, convert them to a "Method" column.
if (!"Method" %in% colnames(final_combined)) {
  final_combined <- rownames_to_column(final_combined, var = "Method")
}
patterns <- c("Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Baseline",
              "Sai_Transfer", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", 
              "pERM_transfer", "Pooled")

final_combined <- final_combined[
  Reduce(`|`, lapply(patterns, function(p) grepl(p, final_combined$Method))),
]
# Recode method names so that variants are combined.
final_combined <- final_combined %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    grepl("^Baseline", Method) ~ "Baseline",
    grepl("^Sai_Transfer", Method) ~ "Sai_Transfer",
    grepl("^Para_Transfer", Method) ~ "Para_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^NonPara_Transfer", Method) ~ "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^Net_Transfer", Method) ~ "Net_Transfer",
    grepl("^ARMUL_transfer", Method) ~ "ARMUL_transfer",
    grepl("^pERM_transfer", Method) ~ "pERM_transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
#final_combined = final_combined |> filter(Method != "Sai_Transfer")
# Compute the maximum MSE across Task columns for each combination of Method, n, similarity, and seed.
max_mse_data <- final_combined %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity, seed) %>%
  summarise(MaxMSE = mean(c_across(starts_with("Task")), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, 
                         levels = c("Baseline", 
                                    "Data Pooling",
                                    "Para_Transfer_Tuned", 
                                    "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
                                    "Sai_Transfer",
                                    "Net_Transfer",
                                    "ARMUL_transfer",
                                    "pERM_transfer")))

# For each group (Method, n, similarity), compute the whisker endpoints and filter out values outside.
# This "non_outlier_data" will be used only for setting the y-scale.
non_outlier_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Use a stricter threshold: coef = 1 (instead of the default 1.5)
    bp_stats <- boxplot.stats(.x$MaxMSE, coef = 1)$stats  
    lower <- bp_stats[1]
    upper <- bp_stats[5]
    .x %>% filter(MaxMSE >= lower, MaxMSE <= upper)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c( "Representation Transfer"))

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c( "Representation Transfer"))
non_outlier_data$Method <- factor(non_outlier_data$Method,
                          levels = c("Baseline",
                                     "Data Pooling",
                                     "ARMUL",
                                     "pERM",
                                     #"Representation Transfer Learning",
                                     "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
                                     "Late Fusion",
                                     "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
                                     ))
# Now, plot the boxplot using the filtered (non-outlier) data so that the y-scale is not influenced by extremes.
CATE_Mean <- ggplot(non_outlier_data, aes(x = Method, y = MaxMSE, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2 , width = box_width) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "Mean MSE",

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color
  ) +scale_y_log10()
CATE_Mean
```

```{r}
setwd(work_dir)
library(dplyr)

files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.RData$", full.names = TRUE)

files <- files[simi_val %in% similarity_list]

files

prepare_data_ <- function(result, file_name) {
  # Define methods to analyze
  methods <- c("Baseline", "Sai_Transfer", "Para_Transfer_Tuned", "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", "Net_Transfer", "ARMUL_transfer", "pERM_Transfer", "Pooled")

  # Generate quantile data for each method
  quantiles_list <- lapply(methods, function(m) {
    quantile_df <- apply(result[result$method == m, "max_value", drop = FALSE], 2, function(col) {
      quantile(col, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
    })
    colnames(quantile_df) <- m
    quantile_df
  })

  # Combine quantile data and reshape it to long format
  quantiles <- do.call(cbind, quantiles_list)
  quantiles_long <- melt(quantiles, variable.name = "Method", value.name = "Value")
  
  # Add a column with the file name for faceting
  quantiles_long$Dataset <- basename(file_name)
  
  return(quantiles_long)
}

all_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(file) {
  result <- load(file)  # Load the RData file (assumes it loads 'result' variable)\
  result <- get(result)
  prepare_data_(result, file)
}))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract 'n' (e.g., 200 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    n = as.numeric(gsub(".*_n_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", Dataset)),
    
    # Extract 'similarity' (e.g., 0.4 from "mse_n_200_simi_0.4")
    similarity = as.numeric(gsub(".*_simi_(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?).*", "\\1", Dataset))
  )
all_data <- all_data %>%
  rename(Method = Var2) |> filter(n!=500)
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_Transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
    

  ))

custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("", value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)

# Plot with customized facet labels
plot <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +  # Apply custom labeller

  ) #+

  )
)
```

```{r}
load("../semi-transfer-learning/CATE_dim8/final_combined_results.RData")  # Adjust path if necessary

# If method names are stored as row names, convert them to a "Method" column.
if (!"Method" %in% colnames(final_combined)) {
  final_combined <- rownames_to_column(final_combined, var = "Method")
}

# Recode method names so that variants are combined.
final_combined <- final_combined %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    grepl("^Baseline", Method) ~ "Baseline",
    grepl("^Sai_Transfer", Method) ~ "Sai_Transfer",
    grepl("^Para_Transfer", Method) ~ "Para_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^NonPara_Transfer", Method) ~ "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^Net_Transfer", Method) ~ "Net_Transfer",
    grepl("^ARMUL_transfer", Method) ~ "ARMUL_transfer",
    grepl("^pERM_transfer", Method) ~ "pERM_transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))

# Compute the maximum MSE across Task columns for each combination of Method, n, similarity, and seed.
max_mse_data <- final_combined %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity, seed) %>%
  summarise(MaxMSE = max(c_across(starts_with("Task")), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
#max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
#  mutate(Method = factor(Method, 
#                         levels = c("Baseline",
 #                                   "Data Pooling Method"
#                                     "ARMUL_transfer",
##                                     "pERM_transfer",
#                                     "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
#                                     "Late Fusion",
#                                     "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
#                                    )))
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
# For each group (Method, n, similarity), compute the whisker endpoints and filter out values outside.
# This "non_outlier_data" will be used only for setting the y-scale.
non_outlier_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    bp_stats <- boxplot.stats(.x$MaxMSE)$stats  # returns vector: [lower_whisker, Q1, median, Q3, upper_whisker]
    lower <- bp_stats[1]
    upper <- bp_stats[5]
    .x %>% filter(MaxMSE >= lower, MaxMSE <= upper)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "NonPara_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion with Nuisance",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
    str_detect(Method, "Net_Transfer") ~ "Representation Transfer",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL_transfer") ~ "ARMUL",
    str_detect(Method, "pERM_transfer") ~ "pERM",
    str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c("Representation Transfer"))

non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  filter(!Method %in% c( "Representation Transfer"))

non_outlier_data$Method <- factor(non_outlier_data$Method,
                          levels = c("Baseline",
                                     "Data Pooling",
                                     "ARMUL",
                                     "pERM",
                                     #"Representation Transfer Learning",
                                     "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
                                     "Late Fusion",
                                     "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
                                     
                                     
                                     ))
# Now, plot the boxplot using the filtered (non-outlier) data so that the y-scale is not influenced by extremes.
CATE_maximum <- ggplot(non_outlier_data, aes(x = Method, y = MaxMSE, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +

  ) +

  ) +
```

```{r}
setwd("../semi-transfer-learning/DR_9_new")

# Load the processed data
load("final_combined_results.RData")  # Adjust path if necessary

# If method names are stored as row names, convert them to a "Method" column.
if (!"Method" %in% colnames(final_combined)) {
  final_combined <- rownames_to_column(final_combined, var = "Method")
}

# Recode method names so that variants are combined.
final_combined <- final_combined %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    grepl("^Baseline", Method) ~ "Baseline",
    grepl("^Sai_Transfer", Method) ~ "Sai_Transfer",
    grepl("^Para_Transfer_Tuned", Method) ~ "Para_Transfer_Tuned",
    grepl("^Pooled", Method) ~ "Pooled",
    grepl("^ARMUL", Method) ~ "ARMUL",
    grepl("^pERM", Method) ~ "pERM",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))

# Compute the maximum MSE across Task columns for each combination of Method, n, similarity, and seed.
max_mse_data <- final_combined %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity, seed) %>%
  summarise(MaxMSE = max(c_across(starts_with("Task")), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
max_mse_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, 
                         levels = c("Baseline", 
                                    "Para_Transfer_Tuned", 
                                    "Pooled",
                                    "Sai_Transfer",
                                    "ARMUL", "pERM")))

# For each group (Method, n, similarity), compute the whisker endpoints and filter out values outside.
# This "non_outlier_data" will be used only for setting the y-scale.
non_outlier_data <- max_mse_data %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Use a stricter threshold: coef = 1 (instead of the default 1.5)
    bp_stats <- boxplot.stats(.x$MaxMSE, coef = 1)$stats  
    lower <- bp_stats[1]
    upper <- bp_stats[4]
    .x %>% filter(MaxMSE >= lower, MaxMSE <= upper)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

y_lim <- range(non_outlier_data$MaxMSE, na.rm = TRUE)

custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),  # Format 'n' as "n = ..."
  similarity = function(value) paste0("", value)  # Format 'similarity' as "similarity = ..."
)
non_outlier_data <- non_outlier_data %>%
  mutate(Method = case_when(
    str_detect(Method, "Baseline") ~ "Baseline",
    str_detect(Method, "Sai_Transfer") ~ "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
    str_detect(Method, "Para_Transfer_Tuned") ~ "Late Fusion",
     str_detect(Method, "Pooled") ~ "Data Pooling",
    str_detect(Method, "ARMUL") ~ "ARMUL",
     str_detect(Method, "pERM") ~ "pERM",
    TRUE ~ Method
  ))
non_outlier_data$Method <- factor(non_outlier_data$Method,
                          levels = c("Baseline",
                                     "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
                                     "Late Fusion","Data Pooling",
                                     "ARMUL","pERM"
                                     ))

non_outlier_data$Method <- factor(non_outlier_data$Method, levels = method_order)
DR_maximum <- ggplot(non_outlier_data |> filter(Method!="Para_Transfer"), aes(x = Method, y = MaxMSE, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Method",
    y = "Maximum MSE",

  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +scale_y_log10()


DR_maximum
```
